epic.name: Curve data
unverifiedAssumptions: Verify the Months and Source column values are filled in on the by-maturity table: rates are matched to maturities by tenor label (e.g. '10Y'); if the formats differ those columns will show dashes.
Verify a date offered as available actually shows rates: the overview came back empty at intake, so the default date may open on 'No data imported'.
Verify clicking a rate's source import opens a real trace: the app assumes the rate's WOID is the one the import trace looks up; if not, every link shows 'Import not found'.
